parameters.value: Compactors i.e. Mobile / Movable Storage Systems of configuration as per detailed specifications. One quantity / piece of offered configuration include specified / offered number of Rows of Single Faced Fixed end unit, Single Faced Movable end Unit and double sided / double faced movable Dual unit covering all bays. Prices quoted are for the entire solution comprising of end units and specified numbers of movable units and the corresponding quantities of Rails, Drive Mechanisms and all other components necessary to make the Compactor / Mobile Storage System operational. The price includes the cost of installation and commissioning of the entire unit at consignee site (excluding the cost of Civil Work which would be got done by the Consignee at his own cost as per design and layout plan provided by the seller).
